title: Statue of Liberty Asal Mein Ek Dhoka Hai? 🗽 #shorts
idea: The massive Statue of Liberty's copper skin is shockingly thin at just 2.4 mm, yet required 91,000 kg of copper.

lines.text: Statue of Liberty ki vishaal body asal mein ek dhoka hai!
Poori 46 meter unchi statue dekhkar lagta hai moti deewar hogi.
Lekin iski taanbe ki poori skin sirf 2.4 millimeter patli hai!
Itni patli skin ke baad bhi kul 91000 kilo taanba laga tha!
Gustave Eiffel ke lachile framework ne ise toofano mein bachaye rakha.
Itni patli chaadar New York ke toofan kaise jhel gayi, socho?

youtube.title: Statue of Liberty Asal Mein Ek Dhoka Hai? 🗽 #shorts
youtube.description:
Kya aap jaante hain ki Statue of Liberty ki copper skin sirf 2.4 millimeter patli hai? Itni vishaal murti itni patli chaadar ke saath 130 saal se kaise khadi hai, dekhiye is video mein!

facts.claim: Statue of Liberty ki unchai lagbhag 46 meter hai.
Statue of Liberty ki copper skin sirf 2.4 millimeter patli hai.
Statue banane ke liye 91,000 kg taanba laga tha.
